name: Yuuutsu no Oukoku
source:
Queen Sofia is making her triumphant return to the United Kingdom of Stachia
after her successful coronation in the holy city of Eruku.

But the aftermath was absolutely terrifying... a great beast raped Sofia,
and made her pledge to turn all the country's citizens into slaves.
This includes the citizens of theirsubordinate nation, The Kingdom of Tesden...

Tesden's days of humiliation begin...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE276794.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
索菲亚王后凯旋返回斯塔奇亚联合王国
在她在圣城埃鲁库成功加冕后。

但后果绝对是可怕的……一头巨兽强奸了索菲亚，
并承诺将全国所有公民变成奴隶。
其中包括他们的附属国家特斯登王国的公民……

特斯登的屈辱日子开始了……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE276794.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
